response.query: What participatory adoption pathways (demo strips, reimbursed pilots, cooperative leasing) most reduce barriers across small, medium, and large farms?
response.answer: Demo strips, reimbursed pilots, and cooperative leasing most reduce barriers for small, medium, and large farms by providing affordable, low-risk entry into new practices. These methods allow farmers to test innovations without full upfront costs.

results.title: Sustainable Farming Scheme 2026: scheme description [HTML]
results.content: Habitat land maintained under this action counts towards the scheme requirement to have 10% habitat on each farm. However, you will need to create temporary habitat under Universal Action 6 to meet the scheme requirement to have 10% habitat on each farm. We will provide clear guidance and support, for example through Farming Connect, to ensure you are aware of what you need to do to meet the requirements of this action and the scheme requirement for 10% habitat on each farm. We wish to recognise the positive actions taken so in these circumstances we will accept land being managed as habitat as equivalent and eligible for the related payment, and contribute to the scheme requirement for at least 10% habitat on each farm. See Chapter 4 for an explanation of this action which is designed to support you to create additional temporary habitat, if you do not have sufficient habitat to meet the scheme requirement for 10% habitat on each farm.
